description: Get per-post analytics (likes, comments, replies, shares, saves, views, reach, impressions, quotes, reposts, bookmarks, and engagement rate), with cursor pagination. Analytics is supported on these platforms only: instagram, twitter, bluesky, threads, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, tiktok, youtube, mastodon (telegram and google-business have no post-level analytics). Pass accountId (from list_accounts) for one account, or OMIT it to merge the top posts across ALL analytics-enabled accounts in one call (merged results don't paginate — pass accountId to page one account). Unsupported fields come back null per platform. Returns a clean empty result when no analytics exist yet.

accountId.description: Account id from list_accounts. Omit to merge across all analytics accounts.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's pagination.cursor. Requires accountId — merged results don't paginate.

platform.description: Optional. Analytics platform (instagram, twitter, bluesky, threads, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, tiktok, youtube, mastodon). Scopes the merged mode to one platform; auto-resolved from accountId otherwise.

name: get_post_analytics
title: Get Post Analytics
